properties.name: SA144
properties.site-address: Parsonage Farm, Parsonage Road, Horsham (North Horsham)
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: The site has been allocated in the Site Specific Allocations of Land Document (SSAL) 2007 for 160 dwellings, policy AL1. The site is located in the built up area of Horsham and is close to services and facilities, so is considered a suitable location for residential development. Although the site owner has indicated that this site is in employment use and not available for residential development at the current time, this site is considered achievable in the longer term. Part of the site has permission for 33 units (DC/13/1890). The remainder of the site is therefore considered developable in the next 15 years
